head: PocketMic turns your iPhone into a karaoke mic with a Bluetooth speaker
dek: PocketMic Karaoke lets you sing along to karaoke videos on YouTube or any song and hear your voice through a Bluetooth speaker with echo and reverb. It was #64 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: No karaoke machine or wires needed. It came out on 5 November and costs $19.99, by Vu Dang Nguyen.
means: If you want karaoke at home without buying gear, your phone and a speaker are enough.
todo: Find PocketMic Karaoke in the App Store; you need a Bluetooth speaker.
thumb_words: YOUR PHONE AS A KARAOKE MIC
